summary: Phase 149O.20L.6A -- Class-B Provisioning Authorization Record Independent Verification. VERIFICATION-ONLY -- no production, contract, or real host change; no CHGR mutation; no provisioning, certification, or activation of any kind. Independently re-verified the CHGR published by Phase 149O.20L.6 (chgr-d4343fa51b9743f3abaeb87a881a78b1) from primary sources rather than trusting L.6's own summary. Re-read CHGR-001 directly (Canonical Identity, Immutable Publication, Authority, Decision Template, Assurance, Record Lifecycle, Runtime Consumption, Phase/Proposal Separation contracts) and independently confirmed the CHGR schema's own decision_template.schema.json documents no record-creation workflow exists for that record type this increment (Phase 143E) -- a repository-wide, not record-specific, fact. Re-read the exact published record and its confirmation/provenance/integrity companions, and the decision-session orchestration file, byte-for-byte. Independently re-ran pcae governance-record inspect/verify, exactly reproducing L.6's reported 7-of-8-passed/1-skipped result. Adjudicated the skipped template_resolution check as Outcome A (legitimately optional): the real eligible-authority mechanism actually used, an AESIC template naming Atila Madai specifically, is independently confirmed structurally distinct from a CHGR artifact via live inspect (rejected with 'carries no CHGR envelope'); the gap that does exist (authority_basis_claimed not populated) is honestly disclosed in the record's own limitations field, not concealed. Independently confirmed: election is a closed 3-option (approve/decline/amend), non-defaulted, explicit first-person selection with a distinct, subject-scoped confirmation statement quoted verbatim from the session's confirmation_responses; scope is bound specifically to Boundary P (not general Class-B/certification/activation); target binding matches the live hostname; plan binding cites the exact L.5A section by path and commit; source binding (git diff against the pinned commit 2e97651e) shows zero src/pcae/**, docs/contracts/**, or scripts/** drift; all three governing contract versions (HMIC-001 v1.3, HMRC-001 v1.1, HBDC-001 v1.0) independently re-read from their own identity headers and confirmed to match the CHGR's pinned versions exactly; every required exclusion is present on the published conditions field itself, not merely phase-report prose; privileged-action disclosure and rollback/fail-closed conditions are present via the cited L.5A document; no mutating CHGR command exists in this repository's current increment besides publish itself, which only creates new records (publication immutability structurally guaranteed); the record is unrevoked and unsuperseded (the only chgr-*.json record anywhere in the repository, no revocation_ref/superseded_by/deprecated_by field); session-to-record continuity is a single unbroken chain (one session ID, one package ID, matching preview digests across all four related artifacts, no mixed fragments); GPC6-REQ-075(b) precedent governance properties (explicit human authority, first-person election, distinct confirmation, proposition specificity, publication, canonical record, mandatory-boundaries preservation) are all independently confirmed preserved by the CHGR mechanism. Independently corrected a wording defect in L.6's own No-Go Confirmations: L.6's own test module (test_no_real_host_provisioning_artifacts_created) and Test Results section directly contradict L.6's claim that 'this phase performed no host inspection at all' -- read-only host inspection (Protected Root existence check, id invocation) did in fact occur; classified Non-Blocking because only read-only inspection occurred, never mutation, and L.6's own report is not rewritten, only the corrected interpretation is recorded here. Boundary P is now INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AUTHORIZED by chgr-d4343fa51b9743f3abaeb87a881a78b1 -- no forcing of this verdict was required, every independent check returned Not Blocking. Boundary C and Boundary A remain explicitly NOT AUTHORIZED (independently re-confirmed via repository-wide search finding no certification/cutover artifacts). Class-B remains NOT PROVISIONED; HATP remains NOT READY; runtime independently reconfirmed unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable). New, independently authored companion test module (does not import L.6's own module) -- 37 tests, re-run three consecutive times, 37 passed each run, no flake. No provisioning, certification, activation, or CHGR mutation performed or authorized by this phase. Recommends exactly one next phase: 149O.20L.7 -- Class-B Real Host Provisioning Execution, which must itself independently re-verify all bindings fresh at its own entry, not assume or merely re-cite this phase's own report.
